answer: Settlement is a timber drive: each identity's proof is a log slid down a ridge flume to the jetty mill, and the flume narrows at the ridge pass, so one bad log jams every log behind it. The jammer pays a delay penalty from its bond to every delayed identity. A fleet floating n logs jams itself: its own clones queue behind any bad log, so the fleet pays penalties to strangers and to its own delayed clones, and its expected penalty grows faster than n as its logs crowd the flume. One honest agent floats one verified log and rarely jams; a fleet's logs delay each other.
